results.command: AI communication and Goal contract review
coverage: maintainer-facing updates lead with product capability, user impact, verification and remaining gaps
GitHub and source-control mechanics are limited to short trailing audit details unless specifically requested or decision-relevant
five distinct Codex windows cover V1 integration, UI/UX, audio core/DSP, Windows runtime/driver, and independent verification
every Goal prompt defines an outcome, boundaries, verification, and a stopping or pause condition
the long-running V1 integrator has a measurable V1 acceptance end state instead of an unbounded backlog
parallel windows retain exclusive write scopes and all existing handoff and evidence requirements

limitations: Documentation and repository-process contract only; no product source, driver runtime, release account, signing credential or machine state is changed.
Goal mode can support long-running work but is not represented as a literal infinite process; each run retains explicit completion and pause conditions.
